  open Group G

    :  (a : Carrier) → a ∙ a ≈ ε → ¬ (a ≈ ε)
    →  (∀ b → b ∙ b ≈ ε → b ≈ ε ⊎ b ≈ a)
    →  ∀ b → (b ∙ a) ∙ b ⁻¹ ≈ a

13:module Group-unique-involution-central where
26:module _ {c ℓ : Level} (G : Group c ℓ) where
31:    cancelˡ-⁻¹ : ∀ x y → x ⁻¹ ∙ (x ∙ y) ≈ y
32:    cancelˡ-⁻¹ x y = begin
33:      x ⁻¹ ∙ (x ∙ y)  ≈⟨ sym (assoc (x ⁻¹) x y) ⟩
34:      (x ⁻¹ ∙ x) ∙ y  ≈⟨ ∙-congʳ (inverseˡ x) ⟩
38:  unique-involution-central
42:  unique-involution-central a a²≈ε a≉ε unique b = result
44:      κ : Carrier
45:      κ = (b ∙ a) ∙ b ⁻¹
47:      κ²≈ε : κ ∙ κ ≈ ε
48:      κ²≈ε = begin
50:          ≈⟨ assoc (b ∙ a) (b ⁻¹) ((b ∙ a) ∙ b ⁻¹) ⟩
52:          ≈⟨ ∙-congˡ (∙-congˡ (assoc b a (b ⁻¹))) ⟩
54:          ≈⟨ ∙-congˡ (cancelˡ-⁻¹ b (a ∙ b ⁻¹)) ⟩
56:          ≈⟨ assoc b a (a ∙ b ⁻¹) ⟩
58:          ≈⟨ ∙-congˡ (sym (assoc a a (b ⁻¹))) ⟩
60:          ≈⟨ ∙-congˡ (∙-congʳ a²≈ε) ⟩
62:          ≈⟨ ∙-congˡ (identityˡ (b ⁻¹)) ⟩
67:      refute : κ ≈ ε → a ≈ ε
68:      refute κ≈ε = begin
69:        a                             ≈⟨ sym (cancelˡ-⁻¹ b a) ⟩
70:        b ⁻¹ ∙ (b ∙ a)                ≈⟨ ∙-congˡ (sym (identityʳ (b ∙ a))) ⟩
71:        b ⁻¹ ∙ ((b ∙ a) ∙ ε)          ≈⟨ ∙-congˡ (∙-congˡ (sym (inverseˡ b))) ⟩
72:        b ⁻¹ ∙ ((b ∙ a) ∙ (b ⁻¹ ∙ b)) ≈⟨ ∙-congˡ (sym (assoc (b ∙ a) (b ⁻¹) b)) ⟩
73:        b ⁻¹ ∙ (((b ∙ a) ∙ b ⁻¹) ∙ b) ≈⟨ ∙-congˡ (∙-congʳ κ≈ε) ⟩
74:        b ⁻¹ ∙ (ε ∙ b)                ≈⟨ ∙-congˡ (identityˡ b) ⟩
78:      result : κ ≈ a
79:      result with unique κ κ²≈ε
80:      ... | inj₁ κ≈ε = ⊥-elim (a≉ε (refute κ≈ε))
81:      ... | inj₂ κ≈a = κ≈a
